scope: extracted after INSERT and final verdict; stub psql failure and fixed restored ROWS, no actual PostgreSQL or Docker
script:
set -u
FAIL=0
psql() { return 1; }
psql -q -c "INSERT INTO t VALUES('after')"
insert_rc=$?
printf "injectedAfterInsertExit=%s\n" "$insert_rc"
ROWS=before
if [ "$ROWS" = "before" ]; then
  echo "PASS: recovered to target time -> 'before' present, 'after' correctly excluded (PITR works, recovery point bounded)"
else
  echo "INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL: expected [before], got [$ROWS]"; FAIL=1
fi
exit $FAIL
